data.name: Rogue Process
data.detailed_description:
Rogue Process is an upcoming first-person shooter created in Unreal Engine 5. Inspired by the early 2000s era of shooters, it blends classic gameplay and level design with modern lighting, audio, AI, and an ominous sci-fi/horror atmosphere.

Survive aboard The Ephemera, a sprawling space station overrun by murderous robots, tactical soldiers, intense boss battles, and dangerous environmental hazards. Upgrade a powerful arsenal of weapons, battle increasingly deadly enemies, and uncover how to stop the rogue process that caused the station's demise.

Developed by Scrapbox Software

data.short_description: Rogue Process is an upcoming sci-fi/horror first-person shooter inspired by the early 2000s era of classic shooters. Run, shoot, and platform your way through The Ephemera, a massive futuristic space station overrun by murderous robots and elite tactical soldiers. Developed by Scrapbox Software.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (20H1 version or newer, 64-bit versions)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or Intel Core i5-2500
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB VRAM, AMD Radeon R9 380 or NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 DirectX: Version 12
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 30 FPS, 1920x1080 (low settings)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (20H1 version or newer, 64-bit versions)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X or Intel Core i7-7700K
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB VRAM, AMD RX 6700 XT or NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended, 60 FPS, 1920x1080 (ultra settings)

content_descriptors.notes: This game is created for a mature audience. There is use of blood and gore, strong language, and violent themes.
